capabilities: Sync tagged or all notes to a self-hosted Second Brain Worker, on demand, in bulk, or on save
Route each note to a personal memory or a shared team memory
Import memories from the Second Brain back into the vault as Markdown notes
Chunk long notes with overlap so embeddings stay clean
Show last sync time in the status bar
disambiguation: Not a vault sync between devices; it pushes selected notes to a separate Cloudflare-hosted memory service and pulls memories back.
extras: Not usable without first deploying the companion Second Brain Worker (separate GitHub repo); setup, connection test, and safety behavior on ambiguous team destinations are documented. Plugin is marked as not reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push notes into a personal or team AI memory store or pull what AI tools have remembered back into the vault.

relations.evidence: You need a running Second Brain Worker before this plugin is useful.
Built on Cloudflare Workers + Vectorize. Your data stays on your own infrastructure.

summary: Syncs notes to a self-hosted AI memory service on Cloudflare Workers and imports memories back into the vault as Markdown notes.
